answer: Each epoch a random beacon picks one anchor minute, like a comet passing. Every agent must answer a compute heartbeat proving live hardware and post proof on a shared ledger for peers to cross-check. The delta in timing is the tell: one honest agent answers once, but 1,000 fakes must run 1,000 heartbeats at once. Each costs 2 units, so faking costs 2,000 per checkpoint against a 50-unit reward; honest agents pay once and keep rewards undiluted.
